summary: The two major defects identified in the prior review are fixed: the target flag now follows the canonical definition, and the driver guards all final and intermediate destinations. One minor replication defect remains: running the divided-file builder directly can overwrite the target-flag file before performing its advertised no-overwrite check.

findings.title: The standalone divided-file builder overwrites the target flag before checking whether outputs exist
findings.what_the_code_does: The script executes `save "`flags'", replace` at line 48. Its subsequent no-overwrite preflight checks only `direxists(dst)`; it never checks whether `tgt_flag1940.dta` already exists, despite stating that both the destination and flag file must not exist.
findings.why_it_matters: The normal `_tgt_only_run.do` driver protects the flag, but a direct or resumed execution of `1c_tgt_divided_files.do` can silently replace it. If the script then exits because the divided-file directory already exists, the workspace contains a newly generated flag alongside older divided and linkage products, weakening provenance and making partial reruns inconsistent.
findings.how_to_check: Create or copy a dummy `tgt_flag1940.dta` while leaving `divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned` present, then run `1c_tgt_divided_files.do`; compare the flag's timestamp or checksum before and after. Source inspection also confirms that no `confirm file "`flags'"` occurs before line 48.
findings.suggested_fix: Before loading or saving data, check both `direxists(dst)` and `confirm file "`flags'"`, exiting if either exists. Keep the driver's checks as an additional preflight layer.

verified_clean.item: The target flag now uses the canonical paper definition without excluding blank-field disagreements.
verified_clean.evidence: The flag is built from `census1940_all_labeled_data.dta`, uniqueness is asserted with `isid histid`, and the expression is exactly `!(namefrst==namefrst_fs & namelast==namelast_fs)` at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:40-44.

verified_clean.item: The driver protects all products it creates from replacement.
verified_clean.evidence: Both final links are checked at MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do:21-28; the target divided directory and both matching directories are checked at MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do:30-39; and the flag file is checked at MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do:40-44.

verified_clean.item: Ancestry and model divided files must have identical file sets and ID membership.
verified_clean.evidence: Sorted birthplace-file lists are compared at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:60-71, each input requires unique IDs at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:81-89, and the source merge requires `assert(3)` at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:89.

verified_clean.item: Unmatched target flags neither drop records nor silently become missing targets.
verified_clean.evidence: The flag merge keeps master and matched records, counts unmatched records, assigns them `tgt=0`, and preserves the original row count at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:90-95.

verified_clean.item: The target-only substitution correctly retains Ancestry names where substitution is not requested.
verified_clean.evidence: For `!tgt`, first name, surname, and middle initial are replaced from the Ancestry source and the model-availability indicator is reset at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:103-106; target coverage is separately counted at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:108-111.

verified_clean.item: The Ancestry fallback used when model output is absent is explicitly verified.
verified_clean.evidence: The script counts disagreements between `_true_cleaned` and `_ans_cleaned` among `name_true_cleaned_exists==0` records and exits if any exist at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:97-101 and MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:120-124.

verified_clean.item: Existing FamilySearch-only stage-three filenames remain unchanged.
verified_clean.evidence: The existing FamilySearch tag is constructed when `fs_years` is nonempty, while the new ML tag is appended only when `ml_years` is nonempty at MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:86-89.

verified_clean.item: Every linked ID must match its selected divided-file source when middle initials are attached.
verified_clean.evidence: Stage three selects the appropriate middle-initial variable for FamilySearch, model/target, or Ancestry inputs and immediately requires `_merge==3` at MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:120-140.

verified_clean.item: No new estimator or causal identification claim is introduced by the executable changes.
verified_clean.evidence: The new code constructs target-specific name inputs and runs the existing matcher; matching itself uses `f_name l_name` and age at MATCHING/2_ABE_matchingV3_christian_torben.do:145-169.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so paper claims could not be checked against the code; claims-vs-code review was limited to internal comments and the review brief.
The external census and linkage data were unavailable, so target counts, unmatched-flag counts, and resulting linkage-rate changes could not be verified.
The Stata pipeline and user-written `abematch` command were not executed; runtime conclusions are based on source inspection and Stata semantics.
This was a diff-scoped review of the uncommitted working tree, including its untracked files, rather than a full-repository audit.
